info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Create Healthcare Appointments Book-v4-spec
info.description: The Healthcare Appointments Booking API enables users to efficiently schedule multiple healthcare appointments in a single request. This API is designed for healthcare providers and appointment management systems, facilitating batch insertions of appointment bookings. Typical consumers include medical facilities, clinics, and third-party applications that integrate scheduling functionalities. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline the appointment booking process and enhance patient experience.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new appointment in the system by providing the necessary details. Ensure all required fields are completed to successfully book the appointment.

requestBody.description: A request to book a new appointment. This body must include the necessary information to successfully schedule the appointment such as the date, time, and details concerning the appointment.

CreateHealthcareAppointmentsBookRequest.title: Appointment Booking Request

requestId.description: A unique identifier for the request.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the appointment.

customer.description: Details about the customer making the appointment.

resource.description: The resource to be booked for the appointment.

priority.description: The priority level of the appointment (e.g., high, medium, low).

amount.description: The amount associated with the appointment.

currency.description: The currency code of the amount.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates if a notification is required after booking.

requestedAt.description: The date and time when the appointment was requested.

channel.description: The channel through which the appointment is being booked.

recordIndex.description: A record index number for tracking.

CreateHealthcareAppointmentsBookRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for booking an appointment.

Customer.title: Customer Information

firstName.description: The first name of the customer.

lastName.description: The last name of the customer.

email.description: The email address of the customer.

vipCustomer.description: Indicates if the customer is a VIP customer.

Customer.description: This schema contains information about the customer making the appointment.

CreateHealthcareAppointmentsBookResponse.title: Appointment Booking Response

status.description: Indicates whether the booking request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique identifier for the booking reference.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the booking operation.

state.description: Current state of the booking request.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the booking request, in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message pertaining to the booking response.

CreateHealthcareAppointmentsBookResponse.description: Response schema for the appointment booking operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the booking.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the booking was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the booking was created by an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Schema containing audit information related to the booking operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
